messages:
Mia (SEO): Heads up  We're finalizing launch posts + webinar landing. Need a tight checklist for SEO tech tasks: canonical policy, query-param striplist, redirects map, UTM naming, schema snippets, and an internal-link plan. Short and actionable please.
Ravi: For canonicals I recommend canonicalize to the clean path (no trailing slash) and include Link headers on server responses. Also canonicalize AMP to canonical desktop.
Nora - Content: I'll freeze the CTA URLs. Proposal: utm_source=redwood, utm_medium=launch, utm_campaign=april_webinar_v2. Confirm so analytics stays consistent.
Sam P: I'll own redirects. Plan: single yaml in marketing repo /seo/redirects.yaml; include regex for trailing slash variants and legacy article slugs. 301s only.
Kevin (Dev): We can add a tiny middleware to strip known session params: fbclid, gclid, mc_cid, mc_eid, utm_test, and any _ga variants. Also add Link canonical header.
Mia (SEO): Great. Add schema checklist for landing: Event (webinar), WebinarEvent/webinarSchedule, FAQPage (3 Qs min), and Organization markup on site header. Nora, annotate landing with where FAQ will live.
Ravi: Internal linking: product -> pillar content -> how-tos. Use descriptive anchor text, avoid generic "click here." Add data attributes like data-seo-anchor for A/B tagging.
Nora - Content: I'll update drafts with anchor suggestions and exact canonical targets. Will drop doc in #marketing-drafts in 20m.
seo-bot: FYI: Last crawl 2024-04-02. 389 warnings. Recommend full crawl after redirects and canonical middleware land.
Sam P: ETA PR for redirects + tests by Mon EOD. Will include smoke test to ensure canonical Link header present for sample pages.
Kevin (Dev): ETA middleware + striplist commit Tue AM. I'll add the YAML path for redirect mapping to the deploy guide.
Mia (SEO): Aim to have all pieces live 48 hours before webinar. I'll create a one-page QA checklist for launch ops (canonical, redirects, striplist, UTM, schema, internal links). Thanks all.
